The test image shows dense whitish-gray fuzzy sporulation covering nearly the entire leaf surface, with veins visible as darker lines underneath. This is the hallmark of **Late_Blight** (Phytophthora infestans) sporulation on the underside of a tomato leaf. The KB confirms: "white fuzzy pathogen sporulation visible on undersides of leaves and lower stems." The Late_Blight reference (Bugwood_50) showed the same type of whitish sporulation patches, just at an earlier stage. No other candidate produced anything visually similar to this dense, white, fuzzy sporulation pattern.
